input.quote: Commerce One hereby grants to Corio a fee-bearing, perpetual and irrevocable, nonexclusive, nontransferable (except in accordance with Section 14.1 of this Agreement), right and license in the Territory
input.rationale: The Section 2 grants are perpetual/irrevocable and expressly transferable in accordance with Section 14.1, which permits assignment on a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets without consent, so the successor-transfer fallback element is met on its material terms (the direct-competitor consent carve-out is a minor point noted only). However, no grant extends to Corio's affiliates and no affiliate concept exists anywhere in the Agreement (Corio's "Customers" are sublicensees, not affiliates), so the licence fails the fallback affiliate element. We add the shortest affiliate extension on written notice and leave all other grant terms verbatim.

ops.text: Affiliates. Upon written notice to Commerce One, the licenses granted to Corio under this Section 2 shall extend to Corio's affiliates (any entity that controls, is controlled by, or is under common control with Corio).

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Our licence position requires that our affiliates be covered, at minimum on written notice; the Section 2 grants run to Corio alone. We have added a short affiliate extension and left the Section 14.1 M&A successor transfer (already reflected in the grants) untouched.
proposal.summary: Extend the Section 2 licences to Corio's affiliates on written notice

mappings.element: Customer's affiliates are covered on written notice.
The licence is transferable to a successor in a merger or acquisition transaction.
mappings.quote: either party shall have the right to assign this Agreement in connection with the merger or acquisition of such party or the sale of all or substantially all of its assets related to this Agreement without such consent
